title: Album Cover with Torn Edges and Hand-Lettered Title
coreRelationships: Monochrome photograph as central subject within a dark, torn frame.
Hand-lettered text subtly integrated into the photographic scene.
Contrast between the realistic photograph and the abstract, textured frame.
Parental advisory label as a distinct, modern graphic element against the textured background.
reuseFormula: Recreate a monochrome photograph of a person viewed from behind, looking into an urban scene. Frame this photo with a dark, irregularly torn border, adding small, muted colored paper fragments to the border. Overlay a hand-lettered, informal script title in white within the upper right of the photo and a standard 'Parental Advisory' label at the bottom center, overlapping the frame.
